summary.text: Marcos Reyes is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 115 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Omar Blanco.
An entrepreneur born in Miami, he is licensed in Florida as a real estate broker associate.

paragraphs.text: Marcos Reyes was born in Miami, Florida, and his career experience includes working as an entrepreneur.
He is licensed in the state as a real estate broker associate.
Reyes advanced from the Democratic primary for District 115 without appearing on the ballot after the August 18, 2026 primary was canceled.
